Requirement: "In _clone_for_memory_branch, when AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED is true (read with parse_bool, default true), first clone only the memory branch: single-branch, with the branch option, no-tags, full history. ... When the flag is false, run the current code exactly." Also: "Ship the new behaviour on: gate only the new code path behind AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED as an off switch."
Expected change site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py::_clone_for_memory_branch — the default (flag on / unset) branch
Evidence of absence: The enabled-path clone at scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3252-3267 passes --depth 1, so it fetches shallow history, not the full history the issue specifies. The implementation gates today's #8287 depth-1 path instead, leaving the issue's full-history path unbuilt. The deviation is documented in changelog.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md and agents.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md, and the test helper at tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py:544-553 also expects --depth 1. The flag's effective semantics are inverted relative to step 1: AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED=false runs the pre-#8287 full clone and unset/true runs depth-1; the issue instead has unset/false = current (depth-1) and true = full-history.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
